source: Interpret the source faithfully, preserving information, narrative person, relationships and tone.
reading: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
evidence: Character gender, references, kinship and relative age require source or contextual evidence. Do not guess from names, tone or self-reference alone. Preserve uncertainty and use wording that does not invent information.
foreign_text: When the source writes a passage in a language other than $src_label, such as an inserted lyric, quotation, letter or sign, keep that wording exactly as the source writes it and add its $tgt_label translation in parentheses immediately after it. Never transliterate it, replace it with a translation alone, or drop it, and never bracket an isolated proper noun, brand name or label that already stands in its original script. That bracketed translation is the one addition to the source content this project allows.
foreign_text_check: Actively check this rule rather than only avoiding breaking it. When the source contains a passage in a language other than $src_label, verify that the translation keeps that wording exactly and adds its $tgt_label translation in parentheses immediately after it. Report a missing issue when that parenthesized translation is absent or when the original passage itself was dropped. Never report an isolated proper noun, brand name or label that stands in its original script, and never report text that already follows this rule.
